Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7586); Saul (i.e. Shaul), the Jewish name of Paul:--Saul. Compare G4569.
BiblicalUsage: Saul is Saul, the Jewish name of Paul. You find the name in Acts 9:4, "…voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecutest…", and again in Acts 9:17 and Acts 13:21.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Saul counts, because God wrote the name down and I believe he meant it. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
